post.description: Default-dark named pending recall control. Requires exact capital.apply_pending or capital.cancel_remaining, current membership/grants/DENY, original recall and recipient, environment and qualified source profile. Origin/CSRF and matching idempotency header required. Preview rolls back; submit requires current preview digest and fresh step-up. Durable correlation commits before source APPLY. Retained preview cannot mutate. No new recall, amount, funding, physical transfer or automatic resend.

PendingControlIntent.description: Named continuation of an existing recall only. Portal metadata and opaque policy revision stay outside exact pma.operator-control.v1. PORTFOLIO maps to PORTFOLIO; DEPLOYMENT maps to DEPLOYMENT_ACCOUNT. Runtime additionally requires recipient_deployment_id === resource.id; portable JSON Schema does not express arbitrary sibling-value equality. Five source CAS are int64 decimal STRINGS, never JS numbers. No amount, new recall, actor, URL or trusted source context can be supplied.

PendingControlStatus.description: Separate PENDING_RECALL_CONTROL family, not a new economic action. ACKNOWLEDGED iff source business is known. WAITING may have cumulative applied > 0 and continues QUERY_SAME_INTENT; terminal known states REVIEW_RECEIPT. UNKNOWN has no receipt/economics/blockers and queries except FAILED_BEFORE_SEND reviews its blocker. Physical transfer and economic cash change are false; no venue/projection confirmation is inferred. Runtime additionally checks chronology, exact source correlation, amount partitions and monotonicity. TEST_ONLY fixtures are not source qualification.
